resources.string: AI Exposure Check
Version %1$s
Free, read-only check
Which AI tools can see or control this phone?

This app makes a list of the apps on your phone and the special access Android has given them. You then see, in plain English, which known AI tools, remote control apps and monitoring apps you have, and how to switch each one off.
What it reads

• The names of your apps, and which app store installed them
• Which apps can use your microphone, camera, location, text messages, call history or contacts
• Which apps have accessibility access (can see your screen and tap for you)
• Device admin apps (can lock or wipe the phone)
• Apps that can read your notifications, your keyboards, and apps that can draw over other apps
What it never does

• Change, delete or install anything\n• Connect to the internet. This app has no internet permission at all, so Android will not let it\n• Read your messages, photos, files, passwords, accounts or anything you type
Where the report goes

The report is saved in your Downloads folder. Nothing is sent anywhere. To see your results, open our report page in your browser and choose the file. Your browser reads it on your phone; it is never uploaded.
